announcements.title: Codex Accounts Manager 0.1.18 — ChatGPT desktop restart and Free quota fixes
announcements.summary: Adds compatibility with the merged ChatGPT desktop app and fixes Free plan, subscription, and monthly quota display consistency.
announcements.content:
This release fixes desktop restart behavior and account quota presentation after Codex moved into the ChatGPT desktop app.
1. ChatGPT desktop integration: detects the merged /Applications/ChatGPT.app, matches its exact main executable, and keeps legacy Codex.app compatibility when switching accounts.
2. Free plan consistency: expired historical Plus or Pro subscription data can no longer override a current Free quota response, and stale subscription expiry data is cleared when Free is confirmed.
3. Monthly quota labels: Free and 28-day-or-longer quota windows are shown as Monthly, while paid 7-day windows remain Weekly across the Dashboard, status bar, details, account switcher, and warnings.
4. Dependency security: upgrades production Undici to 6.28.0 and passes the production dependency audit.
5. Regression coverage: adds tests for ChatGPT process detection, expired subscription handling, Free profile maintenance, monthly labels, and time-stable quota reset behavior.

zh.title: Codex Accounts Manager 0.1.18 — ChatGPT 桌面重启与 Free 配额修复
zh.summary: 兼容合并后的 ChatGPT 桌面应用，并修复 Free 套餐、订阅信息和每月配额展示不一致。
zh.content:
本次更新修复 Codex 合并到 ChatGPT 桌面应用后的自动重启，以及账号套餐和配额展示问题。
1. ChatGPT 桌面联动：识别合并后的 /Applications/ChatGPT.app，按真实主进程精确匹配，并继续兼容旧版 Codex.app。
2. Free 套餐一致性：过期历史 Plus 或 Pro 订阅不再覆盖当前 Free 配额，确认 Free 后会清理旧订阅到期信息。
3. 每月配额标签：Free 或 28 天以上窗口在 Dashboard、状态栏、详情、切号选择和预警中显示为“每月”，付费 7 天窗口继续显示为“每周”。
4. 依赖安全：生产依赖 Undici 升级到 6.28.0，并通过生产依赖安全审计。
5. 回归测试补强：新增 ChatGPT 进程检测、过期订阅、Free 档案维护、每月标签和稳定时间测试。

announcements.title: Codex Accounts Manager 0.1.17 — proxy support and status bar quota control
announcements.summary: Loads Codex proxy settings for extension requests, makes invalid proxy configurations fail closed, and links the status bar's 5-hour quota to its setting.
announcements.content:
This release improves proxy compatibility, quota display consistency, and network safety.
1. Codex proxy environment: the extension loads HTTP_PROXY, HTTPS_PROXY, ALL_PROXY, and NO_PROXY from the process or CODEX_HOME/.env and routes quota, OAuth, subscription, profile, usage, and announcement requests through the configured proxy.
2. Safe proxy behavior: process variables take precedence over .env, including explicit empty values; invalid URLs and unsupported protocols show an error and block extension requests instead of silently connecting directly. Proxy URLs currently support http:// and https://.
3. Dependency security: the production Undici dependency is upgraded to 6.27.0 and passes the production dependency audit.
4. Missing 5-hour display: when the API omits the 5-hour window, its compatibility percentage is normalized to 100% while the window remains marked absent, so automation still ignores it.
5. Status bar control: disabling 5-hour quota control now removes the 5-hour value from the compact status bar and tooltip while keeping the weekly quota visible; setting changes refresh immediately.
6. Plan labels: raw ChatGPT plan identifiers in the status bar tooltip are normalized to readable labels such as Team and Plus.
7. Regression coverage: adds tests for proxy parsing, precedence, fail-closed behavior, real dispatcher routing, missing quota normalization, status bar control states, and plan label formatting.

zh.title: Codex Accounts Manager 0.1.17 — 代理支持与状态栏配额控制
zh.summary: 为扩展请求加载 Codex 代理设置，无效代理配置改为安全阻断，并让状态栏中的 5 小时额度跟随对应设置。
zh.content:
本次更新重点提升代理兼容性、配额展示一致性与网络安全。
1. Codex 代理环境：扩展会从进程或 CODEX_HOME/.env 读取 HTTP_PROXY、HTTPS_PROXY、ALL_PROXY 和 NO_PROXY，并让配额、OAuth、订阅、profile、usage 与公告请求统一经过已配置代理。
2. 安全代理行为：进程变量优先于 .env，空值也可显式覆盖同名配置；URL 无效或协议不受支持时会明确报错并阻止扩展请求，不再静默直连。代理 URL 当前支持 http:// 与 https://。
3. 依赖安全升级：生产依赖 Undici 升级到 6.27.0，并通过生产依赖安全审计。
4. 缺失 5 小时展示：接口未返回 5 小时窗口时，兼容百分比规范化为 100%，同时继续标记为窗口不存在，因此自动化仍会忽略该维度。
5. 状态栏联动：关闭 5 小时配额控制后，紧凑状态栏和悬浮明细不再显示 5 小时额度，只保留每周额度；设置变化会立即刷新。
6. 套餐名称：状态栏悬浮明细会把原始 ChatGPT 套餐标识规范化为 Team、Plus 等易读名称。
7. 回归测试补强：新增代理解析、优先级、fail-closed、真实 dispatcher 路由、缺失配额规范化、状态栏双态和套餐名称格式化测试。

announcements.title: Codex Accounts Manager 0.1.10 免重复授权导入与总览修复
announcements.summary: 本次更新支持通过已登录 ChatGPT session 导入账号，免去重复 Codex 授权和手机号验证，并修复顶部总览展示。
announcements.content:
本次更新聚焦账号导入、跨设备迁移说明和 Dashboard 展示一致性。
1. 添加账号增强：导入 JSON 支持 ChatGPT session 返回数据，可复用浏览器中已登录的 ChatGPT 会话，免去重复进行 Codex 授权和手机号验证。
2. 快速获取 Token：添加账号窗口提供打开当前登录 Token 页面入口，复制返回的 session JSON 后即可导入。
3. 账号迁移说明：README 新增如何导出选中账号 JSON，并在另一台电脑导入恢复的步骤。
4. 顶部总览修复：没有全局激活账号但当前窗口已有账号时，顶部总览会显示当前窗口账号，不再误提示没有激活账号。
5. 导入兼容性增强：兼容 session JSON 中的 user、account 和 accessToken 数据，并从更多 JWT profile claim 兜底提取邮箱。
6. 扩展能力提示：如需更完整的会话管理、CLI 启动和多实例调度，可安装 uTools 插件 AiDeck。

AiDeck 项目地址：https://github.com/wannanbigpig/aideck

en.title: Codex Accounts Manager 0.1.10 session import and overview fixes
en.summary: This update imports accounts from an already signed-in ChatGPT session, avoiding repeated Codex authorization and phone verification, and fixes the top overview.
en.content:
This update focuses on account import, cross-device migration guidance, and Dashboard display consistency.
1. Better account import: JSON import now supports ChatGPT session response data, so you can reuse an already signed-in ChatGPT browser session and avoid repeating Codex authorization and phone verification.
2. Faster token access: the add-account window includes an entry to open the current login token page; copy the returned session JSON and import it directly.
3. Account migration guidance: README now explains how to export selected accounts as JSON and restore them on another computer.
4. Top overview fix: when no global active account is marked but the current window has an account, the top overview now shows that current window account instead of saying no active account exists.
5. Import compatibility: session JSON user, account, and accessToken data are supported, with extra JWT profile claim fallbacks for email detection.
6. Extended workspace hint: for fuller session management, CLI launch, and multi-instance scheduling, install the AiDeck uTools plugin.

AiDeck project: https://github.com/wannanbigpig/aideck

announcements.title: Codex Accounts Manager 0.1.9 打包体积优化
announcements.summary: 本次更新优化 VSIX 打包内容，移除构建期 node_modules 依赖，安装包体积恢复到约 636 KB。
announcements.content:
本次更新聚焦发布包体积与打包内容准确性，不改变运行时功能。
1. 打包体积优化：VSIX 不再包含 node_modules 中的构建期依赖，避免 lightningcss.darwin-arm64.node 等原生二进制进入安装包。
2. 安装包恢复轻量：0.1.9 打包后约 636 KB，相比误包含构建依赖时的约 4 MB 明显减小。
3. 发布内容更干净：VSIX 只保留扩展运行需要的 out、media、announcements.json、package.json、README 和 LICENSE 等文件。
4. 打包规则补强：.vscodeignore 新增 node_modules/**，后续发版默认排除本地构建工具链。
5. 版本公告同步：公告 ID 与 releaseVersion 更新为 0.1.9，确保用户能看到本次发布说明。

en.title: Codex Accounts Manager 0.1.9 package size optimization
en.summary: This update cleans up the VSIX package contents by excluding build-time node_modules dependencies, bringing the package back to about 636 KB.
en.content:
This update focuses on package size and release contents without changing runtime behavior.
1. Package size optimization: the VSIX no longer includes build-time node_modules dependencies, preventing native binaries such as lightningcss.darwin-arm64.node from entering the extension package.
2. Lightweight package restored: the 0.1.9 VSIX is about 636 KB, much smaller than the roughly 4 MB package produced when build dependencies were included.
3. Cleaner release contents: the VSIX now keeps only runtime files such as out, media, announcements.json, package.json, README, and LICENSE.
4. Packaging rule hardened: .vscodeignore now excludes node_modules/** so future releases skip the local build toolchain by default.
5. Announcement sync: the announcement ID and releaseVersion are updated to 0.1.9 so users can see this release note.

announcements.title: 需要更完整的会话管理？试试 AiDeck
announcements.summary: 如需更完整的会话管理、CLI 启动与多实例调度能力，可以安装 uTools 插件 AiDeck。
announcements.content:
Codex Accounts Manager 专注于 VS Code 内的多账号、配额查看与快速切换。

如果你需要更完整的 AI 开发工作台能力，可以安装 uTools 插件 AiDeck：
1. 更完整的会话管理与会话恢复。
2. 支持 Codex 等 CLI 的启动与调度。
3. 面向 Antigravity、Codex 等环境的统一调度层与多实例管理。

项目地址：https://github.com/wannanbigpig/aideck

en.title: Need fuller session management? Try AiDeck
en.summary: For richer session management, CLI launch, and multi-instance scheduling, install the AiDeck uTools plugin.
en.content:
Codex Accounts Manager focuses on multi-account management, quota viewing, and quick switching inside VS Code.

For a fuller AI development workspace, install the AiDeck uTools plugin:
1. More complete session management and session recovery.
2. Launching and scheduling Codex and other CLI tools.
3. A unified scheduling layer and multi-instance management for environments such as Antigravity and Codex.

Project: https://github.com/wannanbigpig/aideck
